{"status":"candidate","chosen_option":"option1","assumptions":["Use Python 3; input positions are valid integers in [0, m)."],"observations":[{"statement":"For each pair, the shorter ring distance is min(|a-b|, m-|a-b|).","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"This calculation gives 16 for (23, 7) on circumference 46 and matches the listed distances for the six pairs on circumference 16.","source_ids":["public1","public2"]}],"artifact":{"code":"import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
m, n = data[0], data[1]
answers = []
for i in range(n):
    a, b = data[2 + 2 * i], data[3 + 2 * i]
    d = abs(a - b)
    answers.append(str(min(d, m - d)))
sys.stdout.write("\n".join(answers))"}}
